# KiwiFS — Full Reference for LLMs

> Markdown filesystem for agents and teams. Searchable. Structured. Versioned.

KiwiFS is a single Go binary that turns a folder of markdown files into a knowledge server. Agents and people read and write the same files over REST, MCP, NFS, S3, WebDAV, or a FUSE mount. Files on disk are the source of truth; search indexes, link graphs, and query caches are derived and rebuildable (`kiwifs reindex`). Every write is a git commit authored by the writer. Search is BM25 over SQLite FTS5 by default, with optional vector and hybrid search. Frontmatter is queryable with DQL. The web UI (embedded in the binary) has wiki links, a graph, Bases, canvas, whiteboards, Kanban, comments, widgets, and a Restructure view.

Documentation: https://docs.kiwifs.com
GitHub: https://github.com/kiwifs/kiwifs
License: BSL 1.1 (each release converts to Apache 2.0 after four years)
OpenAPI (any server): GET /api/openapi.json   Swagger UI: GET /api/docs

---

## Installation

Platforms: macOS or Linux (amd64, arm64), or Docker.

    # Release binary (each build has a .sha256 checksum on the releases page)
    OS=$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
    ARCH=$(uname -m | sed -e 's/x86_64/amd64/' -e 's/aarch64/arm64/')
    curl -fsSL "https://github.com/kiwifs/kiwifs/releases/latest/download/kiwifs-$OS-$ARCH.tar.gz" | tar -xz
    sudo mv "kiwifs-$OS-$ARCH" /usr/local/bin/kiwifs
    kiwifs --version

    # Docker (image ameliaanhlam/kiwifs, linux/amd64 + linux/arm64, tags = versions + latest)
    docker run -d --name kiwifs -p 3333:3333 -v kiwifs-data:/data ameliaanhlam/kiwifs
    # Container runs `kiwifs serve --root /data`; an empty /data is initialized with the kb template.

    # From source (Go 1.27+, Node 20+, make; builds and embeds the web UI)
    git clone https://github.com/kiwifs/kiwifs.git && cd kiwifs && make build && ./kiwifs --version

`go install github.com/kiwifs/kiwifs@latest` does not work (the module lacks the built web UI). Use `make build`.
`kiwifs update` replaces the binary with the latest GitHub release.

Build tags (source builds): `-tags nod2` removes D2 rendering (`/render/d2` then returns 501); `CGO_ENABLED=1 -tags onnx` adds the local ONNX embedder. Release binaries and Docker use the default build. `kiwifs mount` (FUSE) is unavailable on Windows.

Go embedding: `go get github.com/kiwifs/kiwifs/pkg/kiwi`, then `kiwi.New(root, kiwi.WithSearch("sqlite"), kiwi.WithVersioning("git"), kiwi.WithAuth("apikey", key))`.

## Init and Serve

    kiwifs init --root ./knowledge              # default template: kb
    kiwifs serve --root ./knowledge             # http://localhost:3333

- One port (3333) serves the web UI, the REST API under /api/kiwi/, and Streamable HTTP MCP at /mcp.
- `serve` on a folder without `.kiwi/config.toml` initializes it with the `kb` template first.
- `init` never overwrites existing files.
- NFS, S3, and WebDAV stay off until `--nfs`, `--s3`, `--webdav`.
- A file watcher sends direct on-disk edits through the same pipeline (commit author `fswatch`); `--no-watch` disables it.

First write and check:

    curl -X PUT 'http://localhost:3333/api/kiwi/file?path=notes/auth.md' \
      -H 'X-Actor: my-agent' --data-binary $'# Authentication\n\nOAuth2 with JWT access tokens.\n'
    # -> {"etag":"934818f7...","path":"notes/auth.md"}
    curl 'http://localhost:3333/api/kiwi/search?q=jwt'
    curl 'http://localhost:3333/api/kiwi/versions?path=notes/auth.md'

## Init Templates

    kiwifs init --template <name> --root <dir>

| Template | Best for | What you get |
|----------|----------|--------------|
| kb (default) | Curated knowledge bases | Article types, verification workflow (draft → review → verified → stale → archived), freshness checks (stale_days = 90) |
| wiki | Team wikis | Onboarding, decisions, processes, reference docs |
| memory | Agent memory | episodes/, pages/, log.md, consolidation playbook |
| tasks | Task tracking | Task schema, workflow backlog → todo → in_progress → review → done (+ cancelled), WIP limits 5/3, claim fields |
| data | Structured records | collections/, dashboards/ with kiwi-query and kiwi-chart, imports/ |
| cms | Headless CMS | blog/docs/pages/authors, editorial workflow (draft → review → scheduled → published → archived), feeds, public reader at /p/* |
| runbook | Ops and incidents | Severity P1–P4, services typed links, execution staleness (last_executed, last_outcome) |
| adr | Architecture decisions | MADR format, workflow proposed → accepted → deprecated → superseded, auto-numbering (adr_number) |
| prompt | Prompt registry | system-prompts/, task-prompts/, evaluation/ rubrics |
| research | Literature and papers | papers/notes/reviews, reading workflow (unread → reading → annotated → summarized → incorporated), typed citation links |
| log | Append-only event logs | Daily files with `append_only: true`; add entries with POST /file/append or kiwi_append |
| blank | From scratch | Config, rules, and page templates only (no SCHEMA.md, no playbook) |

Old names `knowledge` and `prompt-library` are now `memory` and `prompt`; using an old name returns an error naming the new one.

Every template creates: `.kiwi/config.toml`, `.kiwi/rules.md`, `.kiwi/templates/` (decision, meeting notes, onboarding, product spec, SOP, task), `.gitignore` (ignores `.kiwi/state/`), `README.md`.
Every template except `blank` also creates `SCHEMA.md` (layout, frontmatter fields, naming) and `playbook.md` (written to the root and to `.kiwi/playbook.md`; agents get it via kiwi_context).
List templates over HTTP: `GET /api/init-templates` → `{"templates":[{"id","label","description"}]}`, sorted by label, `blank` last.

---

## Configuration

File: `.kiwi/config.toml` in the knowledge root. Every key is optional. Precedence (last wins): defaults → config.toml → environment variables → explicit `kiwifs serve` flags. Changes apply on restart; `SIGHUP` reloads `[auth]` in place. Any string can use `${ENV_VAR}` (unset expands to empty).

Starter file written by init:

    [server]
    port = 3333
    host = "0.0.0.0"
    [storage]
    root = "."            # informational; --root wins
    [search]
    engine = "sqlite"
    [versioning]
    strategy = "git"
    [auth]
    type = "none"

Sections and keys (default in parentheses):

- [server]: host ("0.0.0.0"), port (3333), public_url (unset; base for permalinks, X-Permalink, share links; env KIWI_PUBLIC_URL), cors_origins ([]).
- [server.cors]: allowed_origins ([]; "*" = any), allowed_methods (GET PUT POST DELETE OPTIONS), allow_credentials (false), max_age (3600). localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1] always allowed. Auth off → no other origins. Auth on + both lists empty → any origin.
- [server.rate_limit]: requests_per_minute (0 = off), burst_size (50). Per hashed bearer token or IP. /health, /healthz, /readyz, /metrics never limited. Over limit → 429 with Retry-After: 60.
- [search]: engine ("sqlite" | "grep"; DQL, Bases, analytics, most health checks need sqlite), async_index (true), index_window_ms (200), index_batch_max (100).
- [search.vector]: enabled (false), worker_count (5).
  - [search.vector.embedder] provider (openai): openai (api_key, model, base_url; alias azure-openai), ollama (model, base_url, timeout), cohere, voyage (api_key, model, base_url), http (url, headers), bedrock (model, region; AWS chain), vertex (project, location, model, credentials_file), onnx (model_path, tokenizer_path; needs -tags onnx build; fetch with `kiwifs model download`; also runtime_path, max_tokens, pooling mean|cls, normalize, query_prefix, passage_prefix, tensor-name overrides). `dimensions` where supported.
  - [search.vector.store] provider (sqlite; alias sqlite-vec, stored in .kiwi/state/): qdrant (url, api_key, collection), pgvector (dsn, table), pinecone (url, api_key, namespace), weaviate (url, api_key, collection), milvus (url, api_key, collection).
  - [search.vector.chunk]: size (1500 chars), overlap (0), context_template ("{{ .Headings }}"; fields .Title .Path .Headings .HeadingPath .Frontmatter), context_hook_url (POST per chunk → {"context": "..."}). Changing chunking affects new chunks only; run `kiwifs reindex`.
- [versioning]: strategy ("git" | "cow" snapshots under .versions/ | "none"), async_commit (true; writes are journaled and recovered on restart), batch_window_ms (200), batch_max_size (50), max_versions (100, cow only). No git binary → warning and `none`.
- [auth]: type ("none" | "apikey" | "perspace" | "oidc"), api_key. Flags --auth, --api-key, --oidc-issuer, --oidc-client-id override.
  - [[auth.api_keys]] (perspace): key (required), space (required), actor, scope ("admin" default | read | write), prefix.
  - [auth.oidc]: issuer, client_id.
- [space]: name ("default"), visibility ("private" | "unlisted" | "public"; only matters with auth on; relaxes GET/HEAD). Change at runtime: PUT /api/kiwi/space/visibility.
- [[spaces]]: name, root (relative to --root), visibility. Or `kiwifs serve --space name=path`.
- [lint]: auto_format (true; table alignment, trailing whitespace, unclosed fences), reject_errors (true).
- [schema]: enforce (false), discriminator ("type"), enforce_level ("reject" | "warn"). Schemas in .kiwi/schemas/{value}.json.
- [links]: typed_fields (default ["contradicts", "supersedes", "superseded_by"]); frontmatter fields indexed as typed wiki links.
- [[validate_write]]: name, match = {frontmatter = "status", value|values = [...]}, reject ("overwrite" | "body_change"), message. Applies to existing files only.
- [sequences] directories: writes there get `<!-- seq:N -->` markers. [format_hooks.auto_sequence] directory, field: next number for new files.
- [workflow]: enforce_transitions (false), [workflow.transitions] map status → allowed next statuses.
- [refactor]: approval_files (50), approval_links (200) (agent plans above need human approval; -1 disables), protect ([] globs), scope (only folder plans may touch), folder_map (page listing allowed folders; unlisted folder = warning).
- [drafts]: enabled (false; needs git), max_active (10).
- [webhooks]: enabled (false), max_workers (4), max_retries (5; backoff 5s → 1h). [[webhook_entries]]: url, events (write, delete, transition, bulk, rollback), secret (generated if absent), path_glob ("**"); registered at startup, duplicate URLs skipped.
- [audit]: enabled (false). Log at GET /api/kiwi/audit.
- [janitor]: interval ("24h"; "0s" = off), stale_days (90), startup_scan (false). [janitor.execution_staleness]: directory, date_field (last_executed), max_age_days (= stale_days), [....flag_values] e.g. last_outcome = "failure".
- [backup]: remote (unset = off), interval ("5m"), branch (current), rebase_before_push (true). Env KIWI_BACKUP_REMOTE, KIWI_BACKUP_INTERVAL, KIWI_BACKUP_REBASE_BEFORE_PUSH.
- [dataview]: max_scan_rows (10000), query_timeout ("5s"), max_auto_indexes (20), [dataview.custom_fields] name = "DQL expression".
- [[similarity.profiles]]: name, match = {field = value}, path_prefix, numeric [...], categorical [...], weights {field = n}. Used by GET /similar and kiwi_similar.
- [memory]: episodes_path_prefix ("episodes/").
- [ui]: theme_locked (false), start_page ("welcome" | "recent" | "dashboard" | page path), custom_css (".kiwi/custom.css"), keybindings_file (".kiwi/keybindings.json"), typed_fences (true), typed_fence_tags (all).
  - [ui.features] (all true): edit, history, publish, graph, kanban, canvas, whiteboard, timeline, bases, data_sources. [ui.toolbar] views = subset of graph, bases, canvas, whiteboard, timeline, kanban, data.
  - [ui.sidebar] pinned, hidden, [[ui.sidebar.sections]] label, paths. [ui.tags] banner (["tags"]), hide, [ui.tags.colors]. [ui.branding] name, logo_url, favicon_url, welcome_title, welcome_message. [ui.keybindings] action = "mod+j". [[ui.editor.slash_commands]] id, label, icon, description, template.
- [assets]: max_file_size ("100MB"), allowed_types (images, video, audio, PDF).
- [import]: airbyte_api_key, airbyte_workspace_id, docker_host ($DOCKER_HOST), prefer_airbyte (true), image_prefix ("airbyte/"), pull_policy ("if-not-present" | always | never).
- [tracing]: enabled (true), output ("stderr" | "file"), file. JSON record per REST/MCP request.

Environment variables: KIWI_PUBLIC_URL, KIWI_BACKUP_* (serve); KIWI_API_KEY (connect, rules, refactor); KIWIFS_API_KEY, KIWIFS_BEARER, KIWIFS_BASIC_PASS (mount); DOCKER_HOST, NOTION_API_KEY, AIRTABLE_API_KEY, CONFLUENCE_BASE_URL, CONFLUENCE_EMAIL, CONFLUENCE_API_TOKEN (import).

Optional features and their "off" status: drafts 501, audit 501, webhooks 503, vector search 503, claims on by default (503 only if the store fails), DQL/Bases/analytics 501 with grep, graph analytics 503 without the link index, Airbyte 503 without Docker or Cloud key, S3/WebDAV/NFS port not open.

---

## REST API Reference

Base URL: http://localhost:3333/api/kiwi (paths below are relative to it unless they start with /api/spaces, /raw, /p, /llms, /mcp, or a probe).
Space selection: `/api/kiwi/{space}/...` or header `X-Kiwi-Space: {space}` (header wins; unknown name → 404). Neither → primary space.

Auth: every mode except `none` needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on /api/kiwi/*.
- `read` keys can only GET/HEAD. Keys with `space` or `prefix` get 403 outside scope. A perspace key's `actor` replaces X-Actor; OIDC uses the `email` (or `sub`) claim.
- visibility public: anonymous GETs allowed. unlisted: GET /file, /peek, /section with ?path= open; tree/search/listing still need a token.
- Always anonymous: /api/kiwi/public/*, /p/*, /health, /healthz, /readyz, /metrics, /api/docs, /api/openapi.json.
- /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt need no token but list only published or `visibility: public` pages unless the space is public.
- /api/spaces and /api/init-templates are NOT checked by KiwiFS; protect them at the proxy.
- /mcp checks credentials only in `apikey` mode (same key). With perspace/oidc, protect /mcp at the proxy.

Request headers:
- Authorization: Bearer token.
- X-Actor: commit author (default `anonymous`; ignored when perspace/oidc sets the actor).
- X-Provenance: `type:id` (e.g. `run:run-249`) appended to frontmatter `derived-from` on PUT /file and POST /bulk.
- If-Match: ETag precondition on PUT /file, PATCH /file, PATCH /file/frontmatter (409 on mismatch; quotes optional). /bulk uses per-file `if_match`.
- If-None-Match / If-Modified-Since: conditional GET /file → 304.
- X-Field-Manager: owner of frontmatter keys set by a frontmatter patch.
- X-Kiwi-Space: target space. X-Kiwi-Source: page-view source label for analytics.
- X-Kiwi-Client: refactor caller label; values starting with `mcp` are treated as agents.

ETag = quoted git blob hash of the content. Writes return it in the ETag header and JSON `etag`.

Errors: JSON `{"error": "message"}` (5xx messages are generic). 400 bad param/JSON/path outside root; 401 bad credentials; 403 scope or bad /raw signature; 404 not found; 409 ETag mismatch, denied workflow transition, append-only file, field owned by another manager, rename target exists, draft merge conflict; 413 body too large (32 MB per file write, 110 MB per request); 415 asset type not allowed; 422 schema validation failed; 428 refactor needs approval; 429 rate limited; 501 feature off or unsupported by versioning backend; 503 optional service unavailable (Dataview, vector search, claims, SSE cap); 500 internal.

Pagination: no global envelope. Offset style (`limit`, `offset`) on /search, /query, /views/:name/execute, /timeline; DQL results carry `total` and `has_more`. Cursor style on /changes (`since` = commit hash, pass back `last_seq`).

### Files

    GET    /tree                    Nested tree up to 20 levels (path). Nodes: path, name, isDir, size, permalink, children
    GET    /file                    Raw file bytes + ETag, Last-Modified, X-Permalink, X-File-Type: symlink
                                    (path*, metadata_only → frontmatter JSON, resolve_links, source; If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since → 304)
    PUT    /file                    Create/replace; body = full content, ≤32 MB (path*; If-Match, X-Actor, X-Provenance;
                                    Content-Type: application/x-symlink creates a symlink). → {"path","etag"}
                                    409 ETag/transition/write hook/append-only, 413 too big, 422 schema
    PATCH  /file/frontmatter        Merge frontmatter, body untouched; body {"fields":{...}} (path*, force; If-Match, X-Field-Manager)
    PATCH  /file?merge=frontmatter  Same, body is the field map itself. null removes a key.
                                    409 {"error","conflicts":[{"key","manager"}]} when another manager owns a key
    POST   /file/append             Append without read-modify-write; creates file (path*, separator default "\n") → {"path","etag"}
    DELETE /file                    Delete as a commit (path*) → {"deleted": path}
    POST   /bulk                    Atomic multi-file commit {"files":[{path,content,if_match}],"actor","message"}
                                    → {"count","files":[{path,etag}]}; one if_match mismatch fails all with 409
    POST   /rename                  Move one file and rewrite every link to it {"from","to"} (update_links=true, overwrite=false)
                                    → {"from","to","etag","updated_links"}; 409 if destination exists
    POST   /rename-dir              Move a folder, relink in and out {"from","to"} (update_links) → {"from","to","renamed","updated_links"}
    POST   /assets                  Multipart upload, field `file` (path = folder) → {"path","markdown","contentType","size","etag"}
                                    413 over [assets] max_file_size, 415 type not allowed
    GET    /raw/{path}              File bytes for <img>/<video>; also /api/kiwi/raw/{path} and /api/kiwi/{space}/raw/{path}
                                    With auth: bearer, valid exp+sig, or an already-public target. SVG gets restrictive CSP.
    GET    /raw-sign                Signed /raw URL valid 30–60 min, per space, lost on restart (path*) → {"path","url","expires"}
    GET    /toc                     Headings (path*) → {"path","headings":[{level,text,slug}]}
    POST   /resolve-links           Rewrite [[links]] to absolute URLs {"content"} → {"content"} (unchanged without public_url)
    GET    /templates               Page templates in .kiwi/templates/ → {"templates":[{name,path}]}
    GET    /template                One template (name*) → {"name","content"}
    GET    /readlink                Symlink target as plain text (path*)

Paths escaping the root or into hidden dirs → 400.

### Refactor (restructuring)

    POST   /refactor/plan           Body = manifest (YAML or JSON, ≤1 MB). Nothing written. (diffs=true, format=workspace-edit;
                                    X-Actor, X-Kiwi-Client). → plan: digest, moves, merges, edits[{path,from,links[{line,old,new}]}],
                                    content_edits, comments, state, removed_dirs, splits, errors, rejected, conflicts, plan_only,
                                    warnings, approval{required,reason}, integrity{unresolved,orphaned,complete}, now, base, stats
    POST   /refactor/apply          {"manifest","digest","approved"} → {"applied":{written,deleted,side_files,removed_dirs,commit},"plan"}
                                    409 digest stale (fresh plan in body), 422 plan has errors, 428 agent plan needs approval
    POST   /refactor/revert         {"commit","dry_run","digest"} Undo any commit as a new commit; 422 if files changed since; 501 without git
    POST   /refactor/approve        {"manifest","digest"} → {"approved","expires_in":"1h"}; agent may apply that digest once
    GET    /refactor/pending        Plans awaiting approval → {"pending":[{digest,manifest,actor,client,reason,at}]}
    POST   /refactor/script         {"script"} Starlark → {"manifest","output","plan"}; read-only, 256 MB, 30 s
    POST   /refactor/from-workspace-edit   LSP WorkspaceEdit renames → {"manifest","plan","ignored"}
    GET    /refactor/raw-moves      Moves that left references behind → {"moves":[{from,to,actor,at,via}],"manifest":{"relinks":[...]}}
    GET    /links/broken            → {"broken":[{source,target,match}],"count"}
    GET    /links/orphans           → {"orphans":[{path}],"count"}
    POST   /refactor/fix-broken     Rewrite broken links to best fuzzy match, one commit per page {"dry_run"} → {"fixes","count","dry_run"}

### Search

    GET    /search                  BM25 (q*, limit 50 max 200, offset, path_prefix, mode=fts|hybrid, boost=none|off, scope,
                                    include_superseded, recency_weight 0–1, modifiedAfter RFC3339, suggest_threshold 3)
                                    → {"query","limit","offset","results":[{path,matches[{line,text}],score,snippet,permalink}],"suggestions"}
    GET    /search?mode=hybrid      BM25 + vector fused by RRF (rrf_k 60) → adds "mode","engines","rrf_k", per-result fts_rank, semantic_rank.
                                    Without a vector index engines = ["fts"], still 200.
    GET    /search/verified         Hard trust re-rank: verified ×2, source-of-truth ×3, outdated ×0.3, deprecated ×0.1 (q*, limit, offset)
    GET|POST /search/semantic       Vector search (query* or q on GET, topK 10, offset, scope, modifiedAfter body only)
                                    → {"query","topK","offset","results":[{path,chunkIdx,score,snippet}]}; 503 if off
    POST   /brief                   Token-budgeted context pack, verbatim, never summarized (query*, budget_tokens 4000, max_pages 20,
                                    path_prefix, encoding cl100k_base) → {query,budget_tokens,used_tokens,tokenizer,candidates,
                                    items[{path,title,heading,content,tokens,score,fts_rank,semantic_rank,partial}],dropped[{path,heading,tokens,score,reason}]}
    GET    /meta                    Frontmatter filter (where=$.field<op>value repeatable, or, scope, sort=$.field, order, limit, offset)
                                    ops = != <> < <= > >= LIKE NOT LIKE → {"count","limit","offset","results":[{path,frontmatter,permalink}]}
    GET    /similar                 Gower-distance neighbors via a similarity profile (path or vector JSON, profile, k 5)
                                    → {profile,query_path,query_vector,fields,candidate_count,truncated,neighbors[{path,score,distance,...}]}

Default soft trust boost: `status: verified`, `source-of-truth: true`, `confidence` (0–1) up; `status: deprecated|outdated` down. Requests with scope, include_superseded, or recency_weight skip it. Query syntax: plain words = AND; quotes, parentheses, `*`, `^`, `:`, or uppercase AND/OR/NOT are passed to FTS5 as-is. `memory_status: superseded` pages are excluded unless include_superseded=true. /search/verified, /meta, and scope need SQLite (else 501).

### Versioning

    GET    /versions                Commits touching a file, newest first (path*) → {"path","versions":[{hash,date,author,message}]}
    GET    /version                 File at a commit, text/markdown (path*, version* full or short hash)
    GET    /diff                    Unified diff as text (path*, from*, to*, granularity=line|word); word → 501 if unsupported
    GET    /blame                   (path*) → {"path","lines":[{line,text,hash,author,date}]}; git only, else 501
    GET    /changes                 Workspace change feed (since, limit 50 max 500, feed=longpoll, timeout 30s max 120s)
                                    → {"changes":[{seq,path,action write|delete|rename,actor,timestamp}],"last_seq"}; 400 unknown sequence

### Metadata, DQL, and Graph

    GET    /query                   DQL (q*, limit 50 max 200, offset, format=json|table|list|count|distinct)
                                    → {"columns","rows","total","has_more","groups"}; total = rows returned, -1 when has_more
    GET    /query/aggregate         (group_by*, calc "count,avg:priority" with avg|sum|min|max, path_prefix)
                                    → {"groups":{"draft":{"count":12,"avg:priority":2.3},"(none)":{...}}}
    POST   /view/refresh            Regenerate a computed view page {"path"} → {"path","status":"regenerated"|"unchanged"}
    GET    /backlinks               (path*) → {"path","backlinks":[{path,count,relation}]}; empty with grep engine
    GET    /graph                   All pages and links → {"nodes":[{path,tags}],"edges":[{source,target,relation}]};
                                    edge targets are raw link text, not resolved paths

DQL, aggregate, and view refresh need SQLite (else 501).

### Drafts (needs [drafts] enabled = true and git; otherwise 501)

    POST   /drafts                  Branch from HEAD {"actor"} → 201 {"id" (8 hex),"branch":"draft/{id}","actor","created_at"}; 409 at max_active
    GET    /drafts                  Array of draft objects
    GET    /drafts/:id              One draft
    GET    /drafts/:id/file         File in draft, text/markdown + ETag (path*)
    PUT    /drafts/:id/file         Write in draft, no If-Match check (path*; X-Actor default draft-api) → {"path","etag"}
    DELETE /drafts/:id/file         Delete in draft (path*) → 204
    GET    /drafts/:id/tree         Tree, same shape as /tree (path)
    GET    /drafts/:id/diff         → {"diff": "<unified diff vs main>"}
    POST   /drafts/:id/merge        Fast-forward main → {"status":"merged"}; 409 if main moved
    DELETE /drafts/:id              Discard branch and worktree → 204

### Views (Bases)

View = JSON at .kiwi/views/{name}.json: name, query (DQL), layout (table|list|calendar|kanban), columns [{property,label,formula,summary sum|avg|count|min|max}], filters [{field,operator = != > < contains in,value}], sort [{field,order}], group_by. Saving/deleting writes directly (no git commit).

    GET    /views                   → {"views":[...]}
    GET    /views/:name             One view
    PUT    /views/:name             Save (query* + optional fields) → {"status":"saved","view"}
    DELETE /views/:name             → {"status":"deleted"} (succeeds if missing)
    GET    /views/:name/execute     Run query + formula columns (limit 50, offset) → {"columns","rows","total","has_more","groups"}
                                    UI filters/sort/group are not applied server-side

### Canvas (JSON Canvas 1.0, files *.canvas.json; other paths → 400)

    GET    /canvases                → {"canvases":[{path,name}]}
    GET    /canvas                  Raw canvas JSON {nodes,edges} (path*)
    PUT    /canvas                  Replace; body {"nodes":[],"edges":[]} (path*; X-Actor default system) → {"path","etag"}
    PATCH  /canvas                  Atomic ops {"operations":[{op add_node|update_node|remove_node|add_edge|update_edge|remove_edge,id,node,edge}]}
                                    → {"path","etag","applied":{nodes_added,...,edges_removed}}; 422 invalid op
    DELETE /canvas                  (path*) → {"deleted"}
    GET    /canvas/query            Filter (path*, q, type text|file|link|group, connected=nodeId, nodes_only, edges_only) → {nodes,edges}
    POST   /canvas/auto-layout      Re-position nodes with Graphviz (path*; body layout dot|neato|fdp|circo) → {path,etag,node_count,edge_count}
    POST   /canvas/generate         Build from link graph {"path","layout" hierarchical|radial|force|circular,"folder","colorize"}
                                    → {path,etag,node_count,edge_count}; replaces existing file

### Workflows (Kanban)

Definition in .kiwi/workflows/<name>.json: {"name","states":[{name,color,terminal,wip_limit}],"transitions":[{from,to,required_role}]}. Pages join via frontmatter `workflow` and `state`.

    GET    /workflows               → {"workflows":[...],"errors":[...]}
    GET    /workflows/:name         One definition
    PUT    /workflows/:name         Save after validation {"states","transitions"} → {"status":"saved","workflow"}
    DELETE /workflows/:name         → {"status":"deleted","name"}
    POST   /workflow/assign         Set workflow + state, no transition check {"path","workflow","state","ordinal","actor"}
                                    → {"path","workflow","state","etag","noop"}
    POST   /workflow/advance        Checked move {"path","target_state","workflow","actor"} → {"path","from_state","to_state","etag","noop"}
                                    409: unknown target, terminal state, no transition, WIP limit, blocked (blocked_by / blocked: true), concurrent edit
    POST   /workflow/reorder        {"path","ordinal","actor"} → {"path","ordinal","etag","noop"}
    GET    /workflow/board/:workflow  → {"workflow","board":{state:[{path,state,title,priority,tags,due,ordinal,blocked,...}],"__unmatched__":[...]}}

### Claims (cooperative leases; on by default)

    POST   /claim                   {"path","lease_duration" (30m, min 1m, max 24h)} + X-Actor* → {path,claimed_by,claimed_at,expires_at}
                                    409 {"error":"already claimed","active_claim":{...}}
    DELETE /claim                   {"path"} + X-Actor* (must hold it) → {"status":"released"}; 403 otherwise
    GET    /claims                  → {"claims":[...]}

### Publishing and Sharing

    POST   /publish                 {"path"} → {"path","published":true,"published_at","public_url":"/p/<path>"}
    POST   /unpublish               {"path"} → {"path","published":false}
    POST   /publish/bulk            {"paths":[...]} one commit → {published,requested,changed,skipped,paths,errors}
    POST   /unpublish/bulk          Same body and shape
    GET    /publish/status          (path*) → {path,published,published_at,public_url,view_count}
    GET    /publish/list            → {"count","pages":[{path,published_at,public_url}]}
    GET    /p/{path}                Public reader, no auth; Accept text/html | text/markdown | application/json ({frontmatter,html,markdown})
    GET    /public/file             Raw public/published file, no auth (path*)
    GET    /public/tree             Tree of public/published pages (path, filter=published)
    POST   /share                   Share link {"path","expiresIn" (Go duration),"password"} → {id,path,token,expiresAt,createdBy,createdAt,viewCount}
    GET    /share                   Links for a file (path*) → array
    DELETE /share/:id               → {"revoked": id}
    GET    /public/:token           Open share link, no auth (password or X-Share-Password); 401 wrong password
    GET    /space/info              → {"visibility","root"}
    PUT    /space/visibility        {"visibility":"private"|"unlisted"|"public"} (saved to config, immediate)

A page is public with `published: true` or `visibility: public` frontmatter. Non-markdown files are served when a markdown page in the same or a parent folder is public.

### Import and Export

    POST   /import                  One page per record (from*, plus source fields: path, file, url, dsn, uri, db, table, query, database,
                                    collection, project, credentials, database_id, base_id, table_id, api_key; prefix, id_column, columns,
                                    field_mappings [{source,target,type string|number|boolean|date,skip}], dry_run, limit, via builtin|airbyte|airbyte-cloud,
                                    airbyte_config, airbyte_image, streams; X-Actor default api-import) → {"imported","skipped","archived","errors"}
    POST   /import/upload           Multipart (file* ≤256 MB, from* csv|json|jsonl|bibtex|sqlite, mode import|preview|infer-fields, prefix,
                                    id_column, field_mappings JSON string, table, query)
    GET    /import/sources          → {"builtin":[...],"airbyte":[...]|null,"docker_available","cloud_key_present"}
    POST   /import/browse           Tables/collections for postgres|mysql|mongodb|firestore → {"tables":[{name,estimated_count}]}
    POST   /import/preview          Same body as /import, limit 1–20 (default 5) → {"records":[{path,frontmatter,body_preview}]}
    POST   /import/infer-fields     Sample ≤100 records → {"fields":[{source,target,type}]}
    GET    /import/connections      Saved connections (array; [] when store unavailable)
    POST   /import/connections      Create/update a connection object (from*; id to update)
    DELETE /import/connections/:id  → 204
    POST   /import/connections/:id/run   Re-run ({"credentials","api_key"} for this run only)
    POST   /import/connections/:id/sync  {"enabled","interval" Go duration, default 1h}
    GET    /import/sync/status      Connections with auto-sync enabled
    POST   /import/airbyte/spec | /import/airbyte/check | /import/airbyte/discover    Local Docker connectors
    POST   /import/airbyte-cloud/check | /import/airbyte-cloud/discover | /import/airbyte-cloud/sync; GET /import/airbyte-cloud/connections
    POST   /ingest                  Convert a server-side document via markitdown (file*, split_mode single|sections, prefix, extract_keywords,
                                    max_keywords 10, convert_crossrefs, actor kiwi-ingest) → {source_file,format,total_sections,output_files,top_keywords}
    GET    /export                  Stream pages (format jsonl|csv|parquet, path prefix, columns, include_content, include_links,
                                    include_embeddings (not parquet), limit). JSONL line: {path,frontmatter,word_count,content,links_out,links_in,embeddings}
    POST   /export/document         Render {"format":"pdf"|"html"|"slides"|"site","path", theme, self_contained, bibliography, csl_style,
                                    crossref, pdf_engine, slide_format, site_name, site_url, repo_url, metadata} → file attachment (5 min timeout)

Notes: `path`, `file`, `db` are server-side paths. A successful import saves a connection (no secrets; dsn/uri saved as sent) in .kiwi/state/imports.json and enables hourly auto-sync for syncable sources (postgres, mysql, mongodb, firestore, notion, airtable, firebase-rtdb); a full sync archives pages whose rows disappeared (`_archived_at`). REST supports postgres, mysql, sqlite, mongodb, firestore, csv, json, jsonl, notion, airtable, markdown, obsidian, bibtex, croissant, and Airbyte connectors; yaml, excel, gsheets, confluence, dynamodb, redis, elasticsearch are CLI-only.

### Analytics and Health (need SQLite engine; else 501)

    GET    /analytics               Dashboard (scope, stale_threshold 30) → {total_pages,total_words,health{stale,orphans,broken_links,empty,no_frontmatter},
                                    coverage,top_updated,engagement{total_views,top_viewed,failed_searches}}

    GET    /analytics/views         Top pages (top 20 max 200, path, since) → {"results":[{path,count,first_seen,last_seen}]}
    GET    /analytics/views/v2      Time series (period 30d, path) → {"time_series","top_pages"}
    GET    /analytics/searches      (period 30d) → {"search_success_rate","time_series","top_failed"}
    GET    /analytics/failed-searches  (top, since) → {"results":[{query,search_type,count,first_seen,last_seen}]}
    GET    /analytics/trends        (period 7d) → {"trending","declining"}
    GET    /analytics/content-gaps  (limit 20) → {"results"}
    POST   /analytics/content-gaps/dismiss  {"query","search_type"} → {"dismissed"}
    GET    /analytics/sources       Views by X-Kiwi-Source (period 7d) → {"sources":{...}}
    GET    /health-check            One page (path*) → {word_count,link_count,backlink_count,days_since_update,quality_score,issues}
    GET    /stale                   next-review passed or reviewed older than days (days 30) → {"staleDays","count","results"}
    GET    /contradictions          Shared tags/topics with different status, or both source-of-truth (path*) → {"contradictions":[...]}
    GET    /janitor                 Cached scan (staleDays 90, fresh=true to rescan) → {"issues":[{kind,path,message,related,suggestion,severity}],
                                    "scanned","healthy","timestamp"}; header X-Kiwi-Janitor-LastScan
    GET    /memory/report           Episodic coverage (episodes_prefix, limit, offset); see Episodic Memory

Janitor kinds: stale, orphan, duplicate, contradiction, missing-owner, missing-status, empty-page, broken-link, no-review-date, decision-found, expired-memory, execution-stale.

### Real-time Events (SSE)

    GET    /events                  Server-Sent Events; `event:` type + `data:` JSON; :keep-alive every 15 s; 503 at 256 clients; no replay

Event types: write (incl. new path of a rename, canvas saves, frontmatter patches, on-disk edits; carries etag), delete (incl. old path of a rename), bulk (paths), rollback (paths), comment.add, comment.resolve, comment.delete, janitor (extra: status, scanned, issues, errors, warnings, duration_ms). Payload: op, path or paths, actor, etag, extra. No file content; re-read when etag differs. No WebSocket endpoint.

### Webhooks (needs [webhooks] enabled = true; otherwise 503)

    POST   /webhooks                {"url"*,"path_glob"* ("**", "concepts/**", "runbooks/*.md"),"event_types":[...]}
                                    → 201 {id "wh_...",url,path_glob,secret "whsec_..." (only shown here),created_at,enabled,event_types}
    GET    /webhooks                Array without secrets
    DELETE /webhooks/:id            → 204

Payload: {"type": write|delete|bulk|rollback|transition, "path", "actor", "timestamp", "field", "from_state", "to_state"}; one delivery per file. Headers: Standard Webhooks (webhook-id, webhook-timestamp, webhook-signature) and `X-Kiwi-Signature-256: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of raw body keyed by the full secret>`. Retries after 5 s, 30 s, 2 m, 15 m, 1 h up to max_retries. In-memory queue of 256; retries do not survive restart.

### Schemas (JSON Schema per type in .kiwi/schemas/<type>.json)

    GET    /schemas                 Array of type names
    GET    /schemas/:type           Schema document
    PUT    /schemas/:type           Save; validator reloads immediately → {"status":"ok","type"}; no git commit

### Spaces Administration (outside /api/kiwi; not protected by KiwiFS auth)

    GET    /api/spaces              → {"spaces":[{name,root,fileCount,sizeBytes,lastModified}]}
    GET    /api/spaces/:name        One space
    POST   /api/spaces              {"name","root" (default .spaces/{name}),"template" (blank)} → 201 space; saved in .kiwi/spaces.json
    DELETE /api/spaces/:name        Soft delete: root renamed to {root}.deleted-{timestamp} → {"deleted": name}
    GET    /api/init-templates      → {"templates":[{id,label,description}]}

### Infrastructure (server root, anonymous)

    GET    /health                  {"status":"ok"}
    GET    /healthz                 {"status":"ok","uptime","version"}
    GET    /readyz                  200 "ready", or 503 "storage-unreachable" | "protocol-unhealthy" with per-protocol detail
    GET    /metrics                 Prometheus: kiwi_build_info, kiwi_uptime_seconds, kiwi_sse_subscribers, kiwi_janitor_issues
    GET    /api/openapi.json        OpenAPI spec
    GET    /api/docs                Swagger UI
    GET    /llms.txt                Page index grouped by folder with descriptions
    GET    /llms-full.txt           All pages' markdown concatenated, frontmatter stripped, capped at 5 MiB
    *      /mcp                     Streamable HTTP MCP

---

## MCP Server

78 tools. Every write goes through the pipeline (git commit, index, events). Write tools accept optional `actor` (default `mcp-agent`).

### Modes

| | stdio (default) | Streamable HTTP |
|---|---|---|
| In-process (--root) | kiwifs mcp --root ~/knowledge | kiwifs mcp --root ~/knowledge --http |
| Proxy (--remote) | kiwifs mcp --remote http://localhost:3333 | kiwifs mcp --remote http://localhost:3333 --http |
| Built into the server | — | kiwifs serve exposes /mcp on its port |

- `--root` and `--remote` are mutually exclusive; exactly one is required. `--space` only with `--remote`. `--port` (default 8181) requires `--http` (endpoint /mcp, health /health).
- Use proxy mode (or the server's /mcp) whenever `kiwifs serve` runs on the same folder, so one process owns the writes.
- Proxy mode sends `--api-key` as `Authorization: Bearer`. HTTP transport requires the bearer key only when `[auth] type = "apikey"`; otherwise it is open. Put remote MCP behind TLS.
- `kiwi_import` works only in local mode (`--root`).

### Client config

    # Claude Code
    claude mcp add kiwifs -- kiwifs mcp --root /path/to/knowledge
    claude mcp add --transport http kiwifs http://localhost:3333/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $KIWI_API_KEY"

    # Claude Desktop / Cursor / Windsurf (stdio)
    {"mcpServers": {"kiwifs": {"command": "kiwifs", "args": ["mcp", "--remote", "http://localhost:3333", "--api-key", "kiwi_sk_..."]}}}

    # Any HTTP client
    {"mcpServers": {"kiwifs": {"url": "http://localhost:3333/mcp", "headers": {"Authorization": "Bearer kiwi_sk_..."}}}}

Config paths: Claude Desktop `claude_desktop_config.json` (macOS ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/, Windows %APPDATA%\Claude\); Cursor `.cursor/mcp.json` or `~/.cursor/mcp.json`; Windsurf `~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json`; Claude Code project `.mcp.json`.

### First calls

1. `kiwi_context` (schema, playbook, index, rules).
2. Find with `kiwi_brief` (token-budgeted pack) or `kiwi_search_hybrid`.
3. Skim with `kiwi_peek` before `kiwi_read`.
4. Write with `kiwi_write` passing `if_match` (ETag from kiwi_read).
5. Verify with `kiwi_lint`.

### MCP Resources

    kiwi://schema                     SCHEMA.md (or a generated schema)
    kiwi://file/{path}                Markdown content
    kiwi://tree/{path}                Directory listing
    kiwi://refactor/plans/{digest}    Full restructuring plan built in this session
    kiwi://refactor/raw-moves         Moves made outside KiwiFS and the relinks manifest that repairs them

### Tool Reference (78)

Parameters marked * are required.

#### Files: read, write, and history (13)

| Tool | Purpose | Key parameters |
|---|---|---|
| kiwi_read | Read a page, optionally resolving wiki links | path*, resolve_links, metadata_only, if_not_etag |
| kiwi_write | Create or overwrite a page as one commit | path*, content*, if_match, provenance, actor |
| kiwi_append | Append atomically, no read-modify-write race | path*, content*, separator |
| kiwi_bulk_write | Several pages in one atomic commit; a stale if_match fails all | files* (path, content, if_match), provenance |
| kiwi_patch_frontmatter | Set/remove frontmatter keys without the body; null removes; you own keys you set | path*, fields*, if_match, force |
| kiwi_delete | Delete a page (history stays in git) | path* |
| kiwi_rename | Move one page and respell every link; destination must not exist | from*, to*, update_links (true) |
| kiwi_tree | Files and folders with sizes | path, depth, include_permalinks |
| kiwi_peek | Title, frontmatter, first paragraph, links, backlinks, outline (~200 tokens) | path* |
| kiwi_section | One heading section by fuzzy name or 0-based index | path*, heading, index |
| kiwi_versions | Git history for a page | path* |
| kiwi_changes | Changes since a checkpoint; store last_seq, pass as since | since, limit |
| kiwi_view_refresh | Regenerate a computed view page (kiwi-view: true) | path* |

#### Search and retrieval (6)

| Tool | Purpose | Key parameters |
|---|---|---|
| kiwi_search | BM25 full-text with snippets | query*, limit, offset, path_prefix, scope, recency_weight |
| kiwi_search_semantic | Vector similarity (needs vector index) | query*, limit, threshold, scope |
| kiwi_search_hybrid | BM25 + vector via RRF; keyword-only without vectors | query*, limit, path_prefix |
| kiwi_brief | Token-budgeted pack; never summarizes; lists what did not fit | query*, budget_tokens, max_pages, path_prefix |
| kiwi_similar | Structurally similar pages via a similarity profile | path or vector, profile, k |
| kiwi_eval | Hit Rate, MRR, Precision@K, nDCG@K for FTS and semantic | set or queries, exclude_prefix, top_k |

#### Context and structured queries (4)

| Tool | Purpose | Key parameters |
|---|---|---|
| kiwi_context | Schema, playbook, index, rules in one call; call first | — |
| kiwi_query | DQL (TABLE, LIST, COUNT, DISTINCT) | query*, format (table, list, json), limit |
| kiwi_query_meta | Frontmatter filters `$.field=value` | filters, or, paths, sort, order, limit, offset |
| kiwi_aggregate | Group by a field; count, avg, sum, min, max | group_by*, calculate, where, path_prefix |

#### Links and graph (8)

| Tool | Purpose | Key parameters |
|---|---|---|
| kiwi_backlinks | Pages linking to a page | path* |
| kiwi_suggestions | Semantically similar, not yet linked pages | path*, limit |
| kiwi_embeddings | Chunk texts and vectors for a page | path* |
| kiwi_graph_analytics | PageRank, components, orphans, hubs, clusters, bridges | limit (20) |
| kiwi_graph_centrality | PageRank and betweenness per page, with degrees | limit |
| kiwi_graph_communities | Louvain communities | — |
| kiwi_graph_path | Shortest wiki-link path | from*, to* |

|---|---|---|
| kiwi_canvas_list | List *.canvas.json files | — |
| kiwi_canvas_read | Read nodes and edges | path* |
| kiwi_canvas_write | Write a canvas JSON object | path*, content* |

Canvas generate, patch, query, and auto-layout are REST-only.

#### Memory (3)

| Tool | Purpose | Key parameters |
|---|---|---|
| kiwi_remember | Save an episode to episodes/{YYYY-MM-DD}/{episode_id}.md | content*, scope, episode_id, tags |
| kiwi_forget | Mark a memory superseded without deleting it | path*, reason |
| kiwi_memory_report | Episodes and whether any page cites them under merged-from | episodes_prefix, limit, offset |

REST-only (no MCP tool): workflow assign/reorder/delete, canvas patch/query/auto-layout/generate, refactor approve/pending/raw-moves/from-workspace-edit, link-health endpoints, publishing, comments, webhooks, schemas.

---

## CLI Reference

Most commands take `--root`/`-r` (default `./knowledge`). `kiwifs --help`, `kiwifs <cmd> --help`, `kiwifs --version`.

Server and agents:

    kiwifs serve          REST + web UI + /mcp. Flags: --root, --port/-p 3333, --host 0.0.0.0, --search sqlite|grep,
                          --versioning git|cow|none, --auth none|apikey|perspace|oidc, --api-key, --oidc-issuer, --oidc-client-id,
                          --async-commit true, --batch-window 200, --batch-max-size 50, --no-watch, --space name=path (repeatable),
                          --nfs, --nfs-port 2049, --nfs-allow CIDRs (localhost only), --s3, --s3-port 3334, --webdav, --webdav-port 3335
    kiwifs init           Scaffold from a template (--template kb|wiki|data|cms|memory|runbook|adr|prompt|research|log|tasks|blank)
    kiwifs mcp            MCP server (--root | --remote, --api-key, --space default, --http, --port 8181)
    kiwifs mount DIR      FUSE-mount a remote server (--remote*, --api-key → X-API-Key, --bearer, --basic-user, --basic-pass, --space)
    kiwifs lsp            Markdown language server; answers workspace/willRenameFiles with link edits (--root = editor workspace)

Restructuring:

    kiwifs refactor plan MANIFEST      Preview; exits 1 on errors (--json, --verbose/-v, --diff)
    kiwifs refactor apply MANIFEST     Show plan, confirm, apply as one commit (--yes/-y, --server, --api-key $KIWI_API_KEY, --actor cli:refactor)
    kiwifs refactor revert COMMIT      Preview, confirm, revert as a new commit (git only)
                                       apply/revert send the change to a running server on --root if there is one

Data:

    kiwifs import         --from postgres|mysql|sqlite|mongodb|firestore|dynamodb|redis|elasticsearch|markdown|csv|json|jsonl|yaml|
                          excel|bibtex|croissant|notion|airtable|gsheets|obsidian|confluence
                          Common: --prefix, --columns, --id-column, --limit, --dry-run, --infer-schema, --save-schema
                          Source: --dsn, --uri, --db, --file, --path, --table, --query, --collection, --database, --project,
                          --database-id, --base-id, --table-id, --sheet, --spreadsheet-id, --credentials, --region, --addr,
                          --password, --redis-db, --pattern, --url, --index, --api, --space
    kiwifs export         --format jsonl|csv|parquet|mkdocs|pdf|html|slides|site, -o, --path, --columns, --include-content,
                          --include-links, --include-embeddings, --limit, --webhook, --webhook-secret, --theme paper|modern|minimal|dark|presentation,
                          --self-contained, --bibliography, --csl, --crossref, --pdf-engine typst|xelatex, --slide-format html|pdf|pptx,
                          --site-name, --site-url, --repo-url
    kiwifs query DQL      --format table|list|json|count, --limit, --sort, --order (run reindex first if the index is empty)
    kiwifs aggregate      --group*, --calc count,avg:f,sum:f,min:f,max:f, --path, --where
    kiwifs view list | refresh <path> | create (--query*, --name, --path)

Quality and maintenance:

    kiwifs check          Janitor + sequence-gap scan for CI; exit 0 clean, 1 issues, 2 failure (--stale-days 90, --json, --fail-on-warn)
    kiwifs lint           Validate against SCHEMA.md; exit 1 on issues (--json)
    kiwifs janitor        Hygiene scan; exit 1 on errors (--stale-days 90, --json)
    kiwifs analytics      Health and engagement (--scope, --stale-threshold 30, --format text|json)
    kiwifs eval           Retrieval metrics vs .kiwi/eval/<name>.qrels + .topics (--set, --list, -x/--exclude-prefix, --top-k 5,
                          --format, --min-hit-rate, --min-mrr, --min-ndcg; non-zero exit below threshold)
    kiwifs reindex        Rebuild FTS (and vectors if configured) (--vector, --fts-only)
    kiwifs widgets list [fence] | suggest [path]   (--json, --root)

Agent setup:

    kiwifs rules [edit | export | sync]   (--remote, --api-key, --format cursor|claude|agents|openclaw|skill, -o/--output;
                                          sync --format skill defaults to .cursor/skills/team-wiki/SKILL.md)
    kiwifs token create | list | revoke <first 12 chars>   (--space, --scope read|write|admin (read), --prefix, --actor)
    kiwifs memory report  (--json/-j, --episodes-prefix)
    kiwifs clip URL       (--title/-t, --tags, --folder/-f clips/, --actor clipper)
    kiwifs model download [all-minilm-l6-v2 | multilingual-e5-small]   (--dir ~/.kiwi/models/<model>)

Backup and tooling:

    kiwifs backup         Push to git remote (--remote, --branch, --rebase-before-push true)
    kiwifs restore        Clone (--from*, --to*, --branch)
    kiwifs bench          Benchmark (--files 50, --bulk 100, --search-files 1000, --search-queries 50)
    kiwifs update         Self-update from GitHub releases (background version check at most once per 24 h)

KiwiFS Cloud:

    kiwifs login          OAuth device flow; session in ~/.kiwifs/credentials.json (--host https://app.kiwifs.com, --client-id)
    kiwifs logout         Remove stored credentials
    kiwifs whoami         Show signed-in user
    kiwifs connect SLUG   Print or write MCP config (--key $KIWI_API_KEY, --write cursor|claude-code|windsurf|claude-desktop|auto,
                          --host https://api.kiwifs.com, --project)

Token keys start with kiwi_ro_, kiwi_rw_, or kiwi_adm_ by scope. `token create` switches `[auth] type` to perspace if unset/none. New and revoked tokens take effect after SIGHUP or restart.

## KiwiFS Cloud

Hosted KiwiFS at https://app.kiwifs.com: runs the server, backups, TLS, and sign-in. Each workspace is a KiwiFS knowledge base with the same MCP tools as self-hosted. NFS, S3, and WebDAV are not available on Cloud.

MCP endpoint per workspace:

    https://api.kiwifs.com/api/workspaces/{slug}/mcp

Authenticate with the workspace API key (workspace settings at app.kiwifs.com) or browser sign-in.

    # CLI (recommended)
    export KIWI_API_KEY=kiwi_sk_...
    kiwifs connect my-workspace                  # print config (reads key from KIWI_API_KEY; safe to commit)
    kiwifs connect my-workspace --write cursor   # write to Cursor (embeds the key)
    kiwifs connect my-workspace --write auto     # every detected client

    # URL clients (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, VS Code, ...)
    {"mcpServers": {"kiwi": {"url": "https://api.kiwifs.com/api/workspaces/my-workspace/mcp",
                             "headers": {"Authorization": "Bearer ${env:KIWI_API_KEY}"}}}}

    # Claude Desktop (stdio bridge)
    {"mcpServers": {"kiwi": {"command": "npx", "args": ["kiwifs", "mcp", "--remote",
      "https://api.kiwifs.com/api/workspaces/my-workspace", "--api-key", "kiwi_sk_..."]}}}

`kiwifs connect --write` targets: cursor (~/.cursor/mcp.json or .cursor/mcp.json), claude-code (~/.claude/settings.json or .mcp.json), windsurf (~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json), claude-desktop (claude_desktop_config.json). Only the `kiwi` entry is added or replaced. `kiwifs login` lets `connect` work without `--key`.

---

## Access Protocols

Every protocol goes through the same pipeline: atomic write, git commit, index update, SSE broadcast.

| Protocol | Default port | Enable with | Auth |
|---|---|---|---|
| REST + web UI | 3333 | always on | every auth mode |
| MCP | /mcp on 3333; stdio or 8181 via kiwifs mcp | always (/mcp) or kiwifs mcp | apikey mode only on HTTP |
| NFS v3 | 2049 | serve --nfs | none; IP allowlist --nfs-allow (default loopback) |
| S3-compatible | 3334 | serve --s3 | Bearer api_key in apikey mode only |
| WebDAV | 3335 | serve --webdav | Bearer or Basic (any user, API key as password) in apikey mode only |
| FUSE | — | kiwifs mount (client) | remote server's REST auth |

- NFS: no portmapper; mount with `-o vers=3,tcp,port=2049,mountport=2049,nolock` (macOS `nolocks`). `.git` and `.kiwi` hidden. Supports symlinks, open-then-delete, stable handles.
- S3: one bucket `knowledge` (one bucket per space with multiple spaces); object keys are paths; signatures not checked; ListObjectsV2 with delimiters and pagination.
- WebDAV: MOVE, COPY, MKCOL, DELETE; large uploads buffered to disk.
- FUSE: needs macFUSE or fuse3; foreground; sub-second mtimes, O_APPEND, symlinks, dir renames; no mmap.
- S3 and WebDAV only check the global `[auth] api_key`; with perspace, oidc, or none they accept every request. Keep them on a private network.
- POSIX level: local root full; NFS near-full; FUSE near-full (no mmap); WebDAV partial; REST, S3, MCP HTTP/tool semantics.
- GET /readyz reports health of enabled protocols.

---

## Agent Playbook System

Every template except `blank` ships agent-facing files. An agent loads them with one `kiwi_context` call.

    SCHEMA.md            Folder layout, frontmatter fields, naming conventions
    .kiwi/playbook.md    Step-by-step tool sequences (the copy kiwi_context serves)
    .kiwi/rules.md       Always/never rules for every connected agent
    index.md             Entry page linking every section (agents keep it current)
    log.md               Append-only change record (memory template)

`.kiwi/playbook.md` and `.kiwi/rules.md` are the only `.kiwi/` files reachable through the file API.

Load context: MCP `kiwi_context`; REST `GET /api/kiwi/context` → {"schema","playbook","index","rules"}. Schema alone: resource `kiwi://schema`.

Typical sequences:

    Ingest:      kiwi_context → kiwi_search (update, don't duplicate) → kiwi_write(path, content, provenance=...) →
                 kiwi_read("index.md") → kiwi_write("index.md", ..., if_match=etag) → kiwi_append("log.md", ...)
    Answer:      kiwi_brief(question) → kiwi_read(page) if the whole page is needed
    Remember:    kiwi_remember(content, scope="user:alice")
    Consolidate: kiwi_memory_report → kiwi_read(episode) → kiwi_write(page with merged-from)
    Restructure: kiwi_refactor_plan(manifest) → kiwi_refactor_apply(manifest, digest)
    Health:      kiwi_lint → kiwi_health_check(path) → kiwi_analytics

Rules export:

    kiwifs rules                                  # print
    kiwifs rules edit                             # $EDITOR
    kiwifs rules export --format claude           # cursor (default) | claude | agents | openclaw | skill
    kiwifs rules sync --format cursor --output .cursor/rules/kiwi.md
    kiwifs rules sync --format skill              # .cursor/skills/team-wiki/SKILL.md
    # add --remote http://host:3333 to read from a running server; REST: GET/PUT /api/kiwi/rules

Provenance: `X-Provenance: run:run-249` (REST) or `provenance="run:run-249"` (MCP) appends to frontmatter `derived-from`.

### Episodic Memory

KiwiFS does not run an LLM; consolidation is the agent's or scheduler's job. Start with `kiwifs init --template memory`.

- `kiwi_remember` writes `episodes/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<episode_id>.md` with `memory_kind: episodic`, `created`, optional `scope` and `tags`; generates `episode_id` if omitted. It always writes under `episodes/`.
- `kiwi_forget` sets `memory_status: superseded`, `valid_until` = now, optional `superseded_reason`; body kept.
- Frontmatter: `memory_kind` (episodic | semantic | consolidation | working; anything under the episodes prefix is episodic unless semantic or consolidation), `memory_status` (active | contested | superseded (hidden from search unless include_superseded=true) | stale), `scope` (e.g. user:alice, project:billing; filter with `scope` on search), `expires_at` or `ttl` (janitor reports expired-memory; nothing deleted), `valid_from`/`valid_until`, `contradicts` (typed link; KiwiFS records, does not detect).
- `derived-from` (set by KiwiFS from provenance) = which run produced the file. `merged-from` (set by you) = which episodes were folded in. Coverage uses only `merged-from`; entries of type episode (matching id or path) or run, session, trace, event, ingest (matching id) count.
- Report: `kiwifs memory report`, `GET /api/kiwi/memory/report`, or `kiwi_memory_report` → coverage_pct, unmerged/total_unmerged, episodic_files/total_episodic, merged_from_refs, contradictions, contested_count, expired_count, avg_age_days, scope_counts, warnings. Cached 30 s. Prefix: `[memory] episodes_path_prefix`.

---

## Widgets

A widget is a fenced code block whose body describes a picture or behavior. The web UI renders it; everywhere else (cat, diffs, export, search) it stays readable text. Typed fences have a YAML body checked against a schema on write.

Fence spellings: bare name (e.g. `array`; renders only when the YAML has one of the fence's marker keys, otherwise stays a code block), `kiwi-` prefix (strict: always renders or errors), `widget:` prefix (strict, legacy). `[ui] typed_fences = false` disables bare names; `typed_fence_tags` allows a subset.

Catalog by category (marker keys in parentheses, then extra aliases; full list via `kiwi_widget_reference` or `kiwifs widgets list`):

- Data structures: `array` (values | rows; arraystack), `matrix` (values | layers; grid, dp), `table` (columns | rows | fromData; relation), `tree` (root | roots | parents | fromArray), `list` (nodes; linkedlist, linked-list), `stack` (values), `queue` (values; ringbuffer, ring-buffer; layout: ring), `map` (slots | entries; hashmap, hashtable; mode: open), `bits` (value; bitmask), `memory` (frames | heap; heap, stack-heap; Python Tutor trace format).
- Charts and plots: `plot` (series; chart-xy), `bars` (values; histogram, barchart), `numberline` (min | max | xRange; number-line), `plane` (points | segments | polygons | circles | vectors | regions; geometry), `timeline` (intervals; gantt, schedule), `kiwi-chart` (bar, line, area, pie, radar, scatter from rows or DQL; Recharts), `kiwi-progress` (bars or radial gauges).
- Diagrams: `graph` (nodes; layouts dagre, layered, circular), `sequence` (participants; seq), `steps` (diagram; mermaid-steps; Mermaid walked step by step, each step stands alone, needs non-empty steps), `mermaid` (focus=/dim= on the opening line, `click` directives), `d2` (rendered to SVG on the server), drawing embeds (`![[x.excalidraw.md|wide]]`, `![[y.canvas.json|full pin]]`).
- Interactive and learning: quiz callouts (`> [!quiz single shuffle ^id] Question`; six kinds: single, multi, boolean, order, match, short; answer keys stay out of search), `kiwi-calc` (assumptions above `---`, derivations below; Tune sliders), `kiwi-playground` (controls exported as JSON, YAML, or a prompt), `kiwi-app` (sandboxed HTML/CSS/JS iframe; height=), `widget:live` (React Live with every widget view in scope; call render()), `widget:code` (runnable Python via Pyodide or JavaScript; lang=python|py|javascript|js).
- Data and queries: `kiwi-query` (live DQL as table or list), `kiwi-data` (structured records with `kind`, queryable via `FROM RECORDS "<kind>"`), `kiwi-kanban` (YAML columns or DQL grouped by a field; drag does not change the file), `widget:tracker` (per-reader progress over numbered folders).
- Page structure: callouts (`> [!NOTE]` and 26 other types, foldable), `:::tabs` with `::tab[Label]`, `:::columns{ratio="2:1"}` with `::col`, `:::figure{width=wide pin caption="..."}`, `:::claim{evidence=... confidence=0.9 source=...}` (queryable via `FROM CLAIMS`; unsourced badge), `kiwi-diff` (annotated diff, optional YAML header above ---), `kiwi-color` (swatches, one color per line), `_book.yaml` (folder reading order and book export).

Writing a typed fence:
- Top-level YAML keys are the widget's properties.
- `steps:` makes a walkthrough; each step is a shallow patch over the previous step (use `frames:` to patch over the base; not both). A step may be a bare string (= note).
- Step keys: note, line/next (highlight code line), label, why, breakpoint, duration (ms at 1x), expect.
- Reserved top-level keys: code + lang, why, link {to, map: index}, props (escape hatch), caption, title, id, clock, width, autoplay, loop, frames, steps.
- Meta string options (opening line): id=, clock= (shared step counter), caption="", title="", width=wide|full, autoplay, loop. Widget properties go in the YAML body, never the meta string.
- A property marked "Fixed across steps" may only be set at the top level.
- Playback: play/pause, step, speed 1x/2x/4x, copy link to step, download step image. URL fragment `#?step.<id>=N` or `#?step=N`.

Validation: writes run the linter; with `[lint] reject_errors` (default) error-severity issues reject the write (broken YAML in a strict fence, wrong type, missing required key, fixed property set in a step). Unknown keys are warnings. Strict `kiwi-array|matrix|tree|memory|numberline|table` with no data key is an error. Bare-name parse failures are warnings. Check with `kiwifs lint`, `POST /api/kiwi/lint`, or `kiwi_lint`. Catalog: `kiwifs widgets list [fence] [--json]`, `GET /api/kiwi/widgets/reference`, `kiwi_widget_reference` (pass `examples: true`). `kiwifs widgets suggest` finds `widget:live` blocks that could be typed fences (read-only).

Search indexes a fence's title, caption, step notes, code, and short labels (not coordinates). Document export replaces each typed fence with its caption and step notes as a blockquote followed by the YAML.

---

## Refactor

Restructure from a manifest (YAML or JSON) into a reviewable plan, applied as one git commit, revertible. Every link to a moved page is respelled in its original style (full path, short name, relative path, markdown link, table cell) and re-resolved; a plan that would break a working link is rejected. Comments, personal state, frontmatter field ownership, and task claims follow their pages. Single renames (web UI, kiwi_rename, /rename) use the same engine and never overwrite a destination.

Flow: plan (nothing written; digest) → review (CLI `--diff`, web UI Restructure view, JSON) → approve if an agent plan exceeds limits → apply with digest (stale digest → nothing written, fresh plan returned) → revert as a new commit (refuses if files changed since).

Manifest keys (unknown keys are an error; at least one of moves, merges, edits, rename_tags, relinks, split):

    moves:
      - {from: guides/a.md, to: guides/b.md}                 # file
      - {from: drafts/, to: archive/drafts/}                 # folder (trailing / keeps names)
      - {from: "notes/**/*-meeting.md", to: meetings/}       # glob; ** spans folders, {a,b} alternates
      - {from_regex: '^journal/(\d{4})-.*\.md$', to: 'journal/$1/'}   # $1 or ${name}
    merges:
      - {from: faq/duplicate.md, into: faq/canonical.md}     # from deleted; links/comments/state move to into; into body unchanged
    edits:
      - select: {paths: [...], glob: "notes/**", query: 'status = "draft"'}   # at least one; glob "**" = all
        when: 'year(date) < "2024"'
        set: {status: archived}
        compute: {slug: 'slug(title)'}
        unset: [reviewer]
        add_tags: [archived]
        remove_tags: [wip]
        replace: [{find: "Acme Corp", with: "Acme", regex: false}]   # body text outside frontmatter and code
        move_to: "archive/{{year}}/{{slug}}.md"
        on_conflict: error            # or suffix("-%d")
        force: false                  # take over keys owned by another field manager
    rename_tags: [{from: ml, to: machine-learning}]          # frontmatter tags and inline #tags
    relinks: [{from: old/path.md, to: new/path.md}]          # repair references after moves outside KiwiFS
    split: [{from: guides/handbook.md, level: 2, into: guides/handbook/, confirm: true}]   # plan-only until confirm
    delete_empty_dirs: true
    now: "2026-10-19T00:00:00Z"                              # pins the clock expressions see

Expressions use expr over the page before the manifest: path, dir, name, stem, title, tags, fm, links, date, modified, now; functions slug(), year(), month(), day(), date(t, layout). Pass the plan's reported `now` back to apply. Frontmatter edits are line-preserving (comments, key order survive).

Conflict codes: exists, many_to_one, case_or_normalization, forbidden_chars, too_long, trailing_dot_or_space, empty_name, dir_cycle, parent_is_file, is_folder. Pages claimed by another actor cannot be moved.

Scripts: Starlark (`kiwi_refactor_script`, `POST /refactor/script`) with read-only functions query(dql), files(glob), read(path), frontmatter(path), links(path), slug(text), json, print; no while loops or recursion; bounded steps, memory, time, reads. Return the manifest from main().

Guardrails ([refactor]): protect globs, scope folder, folder_map page, approval_files 50, approval_links 200 (-1 disables). An agent (MCP, or REST with X-Kiwi-Client: mcp/...) over the limits needs approval: MCP elicitation if the client supports it, otherwise the plan waits in GET /refactor/pending until approved in the Restructure view or via POST /refactor/approve (valid once within the hour). REST apply returns 428.

Safety: apply re-checks every ETag inside the write lock, writes a pre-image journal (.kiwi/state/refactor-journal.json) and rolls back on crash or failed commit. Commit trailers: Kiwi-Actor, Kiwi-Client, Kiwi-Refactor-Digest, Kiwi-Manifest, Kiwi-Base. Plans report `integrity` (already-broken links, pages left with no inbound links) and `stats` (pages, links, rewritten, unresolved).

Interfaces: CLI `kiwifs refactor plan|apply|revert`; MCP kiwi_refactor_plan/apply/script/revert (+ resources kiwi://refactor/plans/{digest}, kiwi://refactor/raw-moves); REST /refactor/* (see REST Refactor); editors via `kiwifs lsp` (willRenameFiles), `?format=workspace-edit`, and `/refactor/from-workspace-edit`. Prefer one plan over a loop of kiwi_rename calls.

---

## Key Concepts

- Files are truth: every page is a plain .md file with optional YAML frontmatter. Indexes (search, metadata, vectors, links) are derived and rebuilt with `kiwifs reindex`. Don't commit `.kiwi/state/`.
- Write pipeline: storage → git commit → index update → SSE broadcast, for every protocol and for on-disk edits (watcher).
- Optimistic concurrency: ETag = git blob hash; send If-Match (REST) or if_match (MCP); 409 on conflict.
- Versioning: git (default; full history, blame, diff, revert), cow (snapshots under .versions/, max_versions 100), none.
- Wiki links: `[[note]]`, `[[folder/note]]`, `[[/root/path]]`, `[[./rel]]`, `[[note|Label]]`, `[[note#Heading]]`. `.md` optional; case-insensitive; `-`, `_`, space equivalent; no prefix guessing. Duplicate names resolve: same folder, then shortest path, then alphabetical. Links in code are ignored. Typed frontmatter links via [links] typed_fields appear in backlinks with `relation`.
- Search: grep (zero index) → SQLite FTS5 BM25 (default) → vector (pluggable embedder and store) → hybrid (RRF). Context packs via /brief and kiwi_brief. Measure with `kiwifs eval`.
- DQL: TABLE, LIST, COUNT, DISTINCT, CALENDAR, TASK, JSON; clauses FROM "folder/" | #tag | RECORDS "<kind>" | CLAIMS, WHERE (repeatable, AND), SORT, GROUP BY, FLATTEN, LIMIT, OFFSET. Implicit fields _path, _name, _folder, _ext, _updated. Functions include lower, upper, length, contains, default, choice, date, days_since, days_ago, dateformat, regextest, round, sum, average, join. Custom fields in [dataview.custom_fields].
- Computed views: page with `kiwi-view: true`, `kiwi-query`, optional `kiwi-format`; output after `<!-- kiwi:auto -->`; regenerated on read when stale or via /view/refresh.
- Bases: saved DQL views in .kiwi/views/*.json with table, list, calendar, or kanban layouts.
- Canvas: JSON Canvas 1.0 `.canvas.json` files (text, file, link, group nodes). Whiteboards: Excalidraw drawings in `.excalidraw.md` files, embeddable in pages.
- Workflows: JSON state machines in .kiwi/workflows/; pages join via `workflow` and `state` frontmatter; WIP limits, terminal states, blocked cards; Kanban board in the web UI.
- Claims: cooperative leases (default 30m, max 24h); they don't block writes; expired claims released every 30 s; refactors refuse to move claimed pages.
- Drafts: git branches in separate worktrees; fast-forward merge only.
- Schemas: JSON Schema per frontmatter `type` (or configured discriminator); reject (422) or warn.
- Webhooks: signed POSTs per changed file for write, delete, bulk, rollback, transition.
- SSE: GET /api/kiwi/events is the only real-time transport.
- Multi-space: several roots, each with its own git history and indexes, on one port; route by /api/kiwi/{space}/ or X-Kiwi-Space; per-space keys.
- Publishing: `published: true` (/p/*), `visibility: public`, share links with expiry and password, space visibility (private, unlisted, public).
- Audit log: per-request JSONL in .kiwi/audit/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl when [audit] enabled.
- Episodic memory: episodes vs semantic pages; merged-from coverage report.
- Refactor: manifest → plan → digest-checked apply → revert, links always preserved.
- Widgets: typed YAML fences validated on write, rendered interactively, readable as plain text.
- Agent onboarding: kiwi_context first; rules exported per harness with `kiwifs rules`.
